items.title: Chico Hamilton interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, January 30, 2000
items.q: It was different from Herschel you know?

ctx.x: Well he filled the other fellas’ chair. Even that was different.

Yeah. It was different from Herschel you know? See that’s another thing about young players today. I was very fortunate man because I came up at the right time. I came up at the right time, and these young dudes today don’t — it’s totally impossible because you don’t have the bands. There’s nothing like a big band — experience in playing with a big band or listening to a big band, or breathing with a big band. There’s nothing like that experience. And thank goodness man, one thing I would say about the jazz…
